courses.title: Practical General Chemistry
courses.description: Past questions from the University of Cape Coast CHE 109 Practical General Chemistry papers (2018/19 and 2019/20): volumetric glassware and calibration, significant figures and error propagation, standards and solution preparation, double-indicator and redox titrations, statistics of replicate measurements and APA referencing. Every calculation has a worked solution.

courses.title: Introductory Practical Organic Chemistry
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast CHE 104 practical organic chemistry papers (2011/12 to 2014/15) and revision questions: recrystallisation, thin-layer chromatography and Rf values, simple, fractional and steam distillation, liquid–liquid extraction and partition, melting point and purity, and laboratory safety.

courses.title: Diversity of Living Organisms
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast BIO 101 Diversity of Living Organisms papers (2015/16 to 2019/20): classification, prokaryotes and viruses, protists, fungi, plants, invertebrates and chordates.

courses.title: Physics Practicals
courses.description: Practical revision questions built from PHY 101A laboratory experiments: Young's modulus, deformation of springs and Hooke's law, helical spring and bifilar suspension oscillations, density by a loaded test tube, and the water equivalent of a calorimeter, with worked calculations, sources of error and precautions.
